International Cheese Federation: Preserving the World's Cheese Heritage
The International Cheese Federation (ICF) is dedicated to preserving traditional cheesemaking knowledge and supporting artisan producers worldwide. The organization works to protect regional cheese varieties from industrial standardization through comprehensive programs including education, certification, research, and advocacy, fostering a global community around the art and science of cheesemaking.

Tradition at Risk

Our Work 
 
Protecting traditions, advancing knowledge, and building community 
 
 
 



 
Education & Training 
 
We develop curricula, fund apprenticeships, and connect new cheesemakers with master artisans to ensure tacit knowledge survives the generational transition. 
 

Learn More → 

 
 
 



 
Standards & Certification 
 
Our certification programs recognize excellence while protecting geographic designations and traditional production methods from industrial dilution. 
 

View Standards → 

 
 
 



 
Research & Advocacy 
 
We publish research on global cheese markets, advocate for sensible food safety regulations, and document endangered cheese varieties before they disappear. 
 

Read Reports → 

 
 
 
 

Explore All Programs 

 
 
 
 
Current Initiatives 
 
Active projects making a difference around the world 
 
 
 



 
Alpine Heritage Project 
 
Documenting traditional Alpine cheesemaking techniques across Switzerland, France, Austria, and Italy. 
 
 
 



 
Raw Milk Advocacy 
 
Working with regulators to develop science-based policies that protect food safety without eliminating traditional production. 
 
 
 



 
Apprenticeship Fund 
 
Connecting aspiring cheesemakers with master artisans for long-term mentorship—because tacit knowledge cannot be learned from a textbook. 
 
 
 
 
 



 
Endangered Cheese Registry 
 
Cataloging cheese varieties at risk of extinction and coordinating revival efforts with local producers. 
 
 
 



 
Climate Resilience 
 
Helping dairy communities adapt to changing conditions while maintaining the terroir that defines their regional character. 
 
 
 



 
Global South Development 
 
Supporting emerging artisan cheese sectors in Latin America, Africa, and Asia through technical assistance and market access.
